title: Cam hand-gesture vocabulary — which hand signal means what, and the action it commands

sources.huawei_share_kit_gestures_share: HarmonyOS Share Kit — harmonyShare.gesturesShare event; app must call sharableTarget.share() within ~3 s

recognizer.engine: scripts/cam_gesture_engine.py — one algorithm meshed from Aaron's three repos: HaGRID labels (pose_map) + hand-gesture-mediapipe keypoint / point-history k-NN (trained live from the submodule CSVs) + HandGestureRecognition key-frame extraction + Cam finger rules; pose fusion → per-hand segmenter → motion head → Segment
recognizer.landmark_source: companion_pwa: MediaPipe tasks-vision GestureRecognizer on-device (Safari WASM) → 21 landmarks + canned label per hand; mac: scripts/cam-gesture-see.py --camera (OpenCV + MediaPipe Hands); pupil: world camera via the same runner
recognizer.runs_on: landmarks (21 points, no pixels) leave the device over the tailnet to Cam's converse server (/api/spike/hand); frames never leave the device
recognizer.coordinate_space: screen space as Aaron sees it (selfie-mirrored, x right, y down, 0..1); sources on the raw frame send mirror=true

pose_heads.rules: finger extension / thumb / palm facing / depth tilt → every one-hand pose; two-hand rules for take_picture / timeout / hand_heart
pose_heads.keypoint_knn: integrations/hand-gesture-mediapipe/model/keypoint_classifier/keypoint.csv (Open / Close / Pointer) — abstains outside its families
pose_heads.external_labels: hagrid → repos.hagrid.pose_map; mediapipe canned → primitives.poses.label; weight 0.9

motion_head.key_frames: integrations/hand-gesture-recognition key_frames_extraction: endpoints + extrema of palm motion energy (≤ 5)
motion_head.geometry: displacement / excursion / palm-length ratio / reversals / angular sweep on the key frames → hold, flick_*, swipe_*, raise, lower, push_in, pull_out, wave, circle_*, translate_out, spread_apart, bring_together
motion_head.point_history_knn: integrations/hand-gesture-mediapipe/model/point_history_classifier/point_history.csv (Stop / Clockwise / Counter Clockwise / Move) on the resampled index-tip track → confidence fusion via repos.hand-gesture-mediapipe.motion_map

recognizer.segmenter: one run = one pose in one phase (still / moving; windowed speed ≥ 0.25 frame/s or palm growth); engagement poses emit at dwell_ms so system.engage fires while the palm is up; two hands with one pose (or a two-hand rule pose) pair into hands=2 segments
recognizer.custom_model: data/gestures/cam-gestures.task (Model Maker export; folders per label + a none class) — optional; the engine already covers every custom pose by rules / HaGRID labels / prototypes
recognizer.frame_rate_note: flicks (< 400 ms) need ≥ 24 fps; holds, swipes, circles, push/pull, two-hand motions resolve down to 15 fps
recognizer.segmenter_reference: integrations/hand-gesture-mediapipe — fingertip point-history classifier (16 frames) is the template for Cam's motion primitives; key-frame extraction from integrations/hand-gesture-recognition picks which frames matter
recognizer.custom_pose_dataset: integrations/hagrid — HaGRIDv2 labels feed Model Maker for every pose marked support=custom
recognizer.runner: scripts/cam-gesture-see.py --camera N | --replay FILE | --demo [NAME] [--post URL] [--record FILE] [--teach-pose ID] [--act]

repos.note: Aaron's repos are mounted as submodules and mapped onto primitives.poses / primitives.motions below. The vocabulary stays the source of truth; repos supply datasets, models, and segmenter patterns. Every repo label is either mapped to a primitive or listed under ignore (log-only, never bound).

hagrid.what: HaGRIDv2 — 1,086,158 FullHD images, 33 static gesture classes + no_gesture, 65,977 people, 0.5–4 m, pretrained YOLOv10 / ResNet detectors + full-frame classifiers; companion dynamic_gestures algorithm trained on the static set
hagrid.role: custom pose training data + label set (Model Maker folders per label); pretrained detector for the Mac/desktop path
hagrid.ignore_reason: call / rock / holy / xsign / thumb_index are reserved for Aaron to teach; middle_finger and little_finger are never bound

hand-gesture-mediapipe.what: MediaPipe Hands (Python) + two tiny MLPs: keypoint classifier on 21 normalized landmarks (Open / Close / Pointer) and point-history classifier on 16 frames of fingertip trajectory (Stop / Clockwise / Counter Clockwise / Move); press k / h to log samples, notebooks retrain to TFLite
hand-gesture-mediapipe.role: segmenter reference (landmark → pose, fingertip history → motion) and the teach-mode pipeline (log samples → retrain → swap model)
hand-gesture-mediapipe.motion_note: Move is refined by direction and speed into flick_* / swipe_* / raise / lower / push_in / pull_out / translate_out in Cam's segmenter

hand-gesture-recognition.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 — academic research only; patterns and datasets, no code shipped in Cam
hand-gesture-recognition.what: Fast and Robust Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition via Key Frames Extraction and Feature Fusion (Tang, Liu, Xiao, Sebe — Neurocomputing 2019), MATLAB; datasets Cambridge, Northwestern, HandGesture (0–9, NO, OK), Action3D
hand-gesture-recognition.role: dynamic-gesture patterns: key-frame extraction decides which frames of a motion carry the gesture; dataset classes seed Cam's motion primitives and counting poses

motions.desc: Pose held with wrist displacement < 4% of frame for the step duration
Fast wrist rotation / short upward displacement then return (< 400 ms)
Fast wrist rotation / short downward displacement then return (< 400 ms)
Short leftward displacement then return, screen-relative after handedness mirror
Short rightward displacement then return, screen-relative after handedness mirror
Sustained leftward translate ≥ 25% of frame width
Sustained rightward translate ≥ 25% of frame width
Hand bounding box grows ≥ 1.6× within 600 ms (approaching the screen)
Hand bounding box shrinks ≤ 0.6× within 600 ms (retreating from the screen)
≥ 2 left-right oscillations within 1.2 s while pose held

Sustained displacement of unknown direction (hand-gesture-mediapipe 'Move'); the segmenter refines it into flick_* / swipe_* / raise / lower / push_in / pull_out / translate_out before a gesture can match
Pose held while the hand leaves the frame or the engagement distance
Vertical translate up ≥ 20% of frame height
Vertical translate down ≥ 20% of frame height
Palm toward self, fingers curl and re-extend ≥ 2× within 1.5 s
Two hands: wrist distance grows ≥ 1.5× within 800 ms
Two hands: wrist distance shrinks ≤ 0.66× within 800 ms

contexts.desc: Long transcript, vault note, or document view
Cam has offered a numbered choice (1–5)
Cam is waiting on a low-risk yes/no
A handoff payload is held (grab happened, release pending)
Aaron is teaching a new gesture or meaning

engagement.glyph: hand icon at the top of the screen (Huawei convention) — the next motion inside the window is read as a command

tie_break: longer match (more steps) over shorter — a fist→palm sequence beats a lone palm push
grammar.handedness: Left-hand motions are mirrored so flick/swipe directions are screen-relative, not hand-relative
grammar.two_hands: Both-hand gestures need both hands labeled within 300 ms of each other
grammar.unbound: A recognized gesture with no binding in the active context resolves to system.log_only (mesh/gestures) so it can be taught later

grab_disambiguation.huawei_note: On HarmonyOS 5 the same grab triggers Grabshot and Air Transfer together when both switches are on; Cam resolves by the follow-up motion instead of firing both

learning.principle: Cam recognizes with the vocabulary below and remembers what Aaron teaches on top of it. Defaults live in git; learned bindings live in data/gestures/learned.json and are distilled to mesh/gestures + MemoryBear.
teach_flow: Aaron says 'Cam, learn this gesture' (or runs cam-gestures.py teach) → context 'teach'
Aaron performs the gesture 3–5 times; only landmark sequences are kept locally (data/gestures/samples/), never frames
Aaron states the meaning and picks an action from actions.json (or 'log only')
Cam replays: 'When you do <gesture> while <context>, I will <action>' → thumb_up confirms, thumb_down discards
Binding is written with provenance {taught_by: Aaron, taught_at, samples, context} and mirrored to mesh/gestures
learning.conflict_policy: Re-binding a gesture that already has a default or learned meaning in the same context requires an explicit replace; otherwise Cam refuses and reports the existing meaning
learning.feedback: converse.confirm / converse.reject within 5 s after a gesture action is logged as reinforcement; confidence_min adapts per gesture within [0.6, 0.95]; reject rate > 30% over 20 uses flags the gesture for recalibration in gesture-check
learning.forgetting: Learned bindings unused for 90 days are flagged stale in doctor output; nothing is auto-deleted — only Aaron forgets
learning.custom_model: Custom poses start from HaGRIDv2 folders (integrations/hagrid, labels in repos.hagrid.pose_map) so Cam recognizes them before Aaron has shown a single sample; once ≥ 30 of Aaron's own samples exist for a pose they are added to the folder and Model Maker retrains data/gestures/cam-gestures.task offline (switch.cam_enhance gate for shipping the new model). Motion classes retrain the point-history way (integrations/hand-gesture-mediapipe notebooks).

gestures.name: Engage (palm to screen)
gestures.meaning: I am about to give you a hand command — watch my hand.
gestures.huawei_equivalent: Hold palm 20–40 cm from the screen until the hand icon appears

gestures.name: Grab and let go (collapse)
gestures.meaning: Collapse the page — fold what I'm looking at down to its compact state.
gestures.notes: Same grab primitive as Huawei Grabshot / Air Transfer; the quick re-open in place is what makes it 'collapse'

gestures.name: Fist bursts open (expand)
gestures.meaning: Expand the page — open what I'm looking at to its full state.
gestures.notes: Starts from a fist so it never collides with the palm-first grab family

gestures.name: Air scroll up
gestures.meaning: Scroll up (or raise volume in media).
gestures.huawei_equivalent: Air scroll up — palm facing screen, fingers up, flick wrist down

gestures.name: Air scroll down
gestures.meaning: Scroll down (or lower volume in media).
gestures.huawei_equivalent: Air scroll down — back of hand, fingers down, flick wrist up

gestures.name: Air scroll left (previous)
gestures.meaning: Go to the previous page / card.
gestures.huawei_equivalent: Air scroll left — palm, fingers pointing right, flick wrist left (Gallery / e-books)

gestures.name: Air scroll right (next)
gestures.meaning: Go to the next page / card.
gestures.huawei_equivalent: Air scroll right — back of hand, fingers pointing left, flick wrist right

gestures.name: Swipe left
gestures.meaning: Next (page moves left, like a touch swipe).
gestures.notes: Touch-convention alternative to the Huawei flick pair; only in gallery so it cannot fight air_scroll_left

gestures.name: Swipe right
gestures.meaning: Previous (page moves right, like a touch swipe).

gestures.name: Grabshot (hold the grab)
gestures.meaning: Capture what's on screen right now.

gestures.name: Grab and carry (handoff start)
gestures.meaning: Pick this up — I'm taking Cam (this page / this session) to another device.
gestures.huawei_equivalent: AI Air Transfer — open palm at half an arm from the screen, pause, clench fist to grab, keep the fist and move to the receiving device
gestures.notes: Enters context 'carrying' on the converse server for carry_ttl_ms; the payload is a session snapshot, not a file copy

gestures.name: Open hand at the other device (handoff finish)
gestures.meaning: Put it down here — continue Cam on this device.
gestures.huawei_equivalent: AI Air Transfer — hold the fist in front of the receiving screen, pause, open the palm to send (devices ≥ 40 cm apart recommended)
gestures.notes: Only the device whose camera sees the release claims the payload; iPhone → iPad is the first target pair (config/network/ios-devices.json)

gestures.name: Wave off while carrying
gestures.meaning: Never mind — keep Cam where it was.

gestures.name: Beckon (come here)
gestures.meaning: Come here — move Cam's live session to the device I'm beckoning at.
gestures.notes: Shortcut for the grab → release pair when Aaron is already at the target device

gestures.name: Wave (attention)
gestures.meaning: Cam, I'm here — pay attention to me on this device.
gestures.notes: Always-on; in context 'carrying' the same wave means cancel (handoff_cancel wins by context)

gestures.name: Stop hand (halt)
gestures.meaning: Stop talking / stop what you're doing on screen.
gestures.notes: Bound only while Cam is speaking so a plain engage palm elsewhere is not read as stop

gestures.name: Air press (palm pushes in)
gestures.meaning: Pause / resume Cam's presence (face + voice).
gestures.huawei_equivalent: Air press — move palm from 30–40 cm to about 5 cm to answer a call or pause/resume playback

gestures.name: Thumbs up (yes)
gestures.meaning: Yes / go ahead with the low-risk thing you just asked.
gestures.notes: Never a Sentinel approval channel in v1 — egress / spend / self_modify stay with cam-sentinel.py approve

gestures.name: Thumbs up (nice one)
gestures.meaning: That was helpful — remember to do it like that.

gestures.name: Thumbs down (no)
gestures.meaning: No / dismiss that.

gestures.name: I-love-you sign (thanks, Cam)
gestures.meaning: Thanks — strong positive feedback on the last turn.

gestures.name: Point and push (air tap)
gestures.meaning: Select the thing I'm pointing at.

gestures.name: One finger (option 1)
gestures.meaning: Option one.

gestures.name: Two fingers (option 2)
gestures.meaning: Option two.

gestures.name: Three fingers (option 3)
gestures.meaning: Option three.

gestures.name: Four fingers (option 4)
gestures.meaning: Option four.

gestures.name: Five fingers (option 5)
gestures.meaning: Option five.
gestures.notes: Longer dwell than engage so the palm is unambiguous inside a choice

gestures.name: V sign (camera preview)
gestures.meaning: Show / hide the camera preview.

gestures.name: OK sign (done / accept)
gestures.meaning: OK, that's done / I accept this.

gestures.name: Circle clockwise (again)
gestures.meaning: Say that again.

gestures.name: Circle counter-clockwise (undo)
gestures.meaning: Undo that last screen change.

gestures.name: Palm up rising (louder)
gestures.meaning: Louder.

gestures.name: Palm down lowering (quieter)
gestures.meaning: Quieter (mute at the floor).

gestures.name: Two hands spread (zoom in)
gestures.meaning: Bigger — zoom in.

gestures.name: Two hands together (zoom out)
gestures.meaning: Smaller — zoom out.

gestures.name: Fist opens twice (home)
gestures.meaning: Take me home.

gestures.name: Pinch and hold (remember this)
gestures.meaning: Remember this moment.

gestures.name: Back-of-hand flick away (forget that)
gestures.meaning: Never mind — forget what I just had you remember.
gestures.notes: Double flick so a single air_scroll_right is never mistaken for a forget

gestures.name: Point at something (what's that?)
gestures.meaning: Look at what I'm pointing at and tell me what it is.

gestures.name: Both palms up and still (hold everything)
gestures.meaning: Everything on hold — pause all motors for this session.
gestures.notes: Soft hold only; switch.kill remains Aaron voice/CLI

gestures.name: Finger over lips (mute)
gestures.meaning: Quiet — mute Cam's voice for now (same sign again unmutes).
gestures.notes: HaGRIDv2 class 'mute' — trained pose, needs the face in frame so the index sits over the lips

gestures.name: Two-hand viewfinder (take a picture)
gestures.meaning: Capture what's on screen — the unambiguous version of Grabshot.
gestures.notes: HaGRIDv2 class 'take_picture'; never collides with the grab family because it is two-handed

gestures.name: Referee T (time out)
gestures.meaning: Time out — everything on hold for this session.
gestures.notes: HaGRIDv2 class 'timeout'; alternative to two open palms

gestures.name: Hand heart (love it)
gestures.meaning: Loved that — strongest positive feedback on the last turn.
